THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
CITY ORNAMENT
033
42 / Sage Qipao
Wavy black hair with blunt bangs, strong blush, a deep
red lip and long silver tassel earrings. A sage-green jacquard
mini dress with a mandarin collar, silver knot buttons, puff
sleeves, a ruched bust and a layered tulle skirt, worn with black
knee-high boots. Delicate butterfly tattoos show on her forearm.
43 / Brocade Avenue
A city-street full-length portrait: long straight copper-red
hair, bold red lips, a black velvet longline coat over a lace-collared
top with long pearl chains, and a floor-length gold-and-black
brocade skirt with a ragged hem. Black iron railings, stone steps
and autumn leaves line the road.
